<!-- Hey there. Thank you so much for improving NewPipe, and filling out the details. Having roughly the same layout helps everyone considerably :)-->

#### What is it?
- [x] Bugfix (user facing)
- [ ] Feature (user facing)
- [x] Codebase improvement (dev facing)
- [ ] Meta improvement to the project (dev facing)

#### Description of the changes in your PR
This is the rebased #3777, and also contains:
- Setting migration that enables SAF everywhere possible.

Other than that, it is identical to #3777 (by @wb9688):
1. Use SAF or NoNonsense-FilePicker *everywhere* based on the setting.
2. Don't have `requestLegacyExternalStorage` anymore in the manifest.
3. Allow only NoNonsense-FilePicker for versions below Android 5 and allow only SAF starting at Android 10.
4. Move `SharpInputStream` into NewPipe and add `SharpOutputStream`.
5. Show folder picker in download dialog if no download folder set yet.

#### TODO
- [x] "SAF" in the UI should be replaced with something more easily understandable for non-Android devs, like "system folder picker"
- [x] Remove "some devices are not compatible" from SAF setting description
- [x] Investigate whether renaming the zip works - it works
- [x] ~~Keeping the setting in the Download menu doesn't make sense anymore~~ implementing a miscellaneous menu is left for another PR
- [x] Investigate "NewPipe saf Leaks" - I can't understand why the name changed, but it's not important
- [x] Explain SharpOutputStream
- [x] "filename.mp4 (1)" is created instead of "filename (1).mp4" - fixed by passing mime type to file picker
- [x] Fix strange behaviour when app loses access to saf download folder
- [x] Reimplement storing import/export path

#### Fixes the following issue(s)
Fixes #3465, fixes #5198, and perhaps some others.

#### Due diligence
- [x] I read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).

review_comment: Could you add an explanation what the difference of this and `SharpOutputStream` to normal java streams is and why it is needed. The `SharpStream` class only tells me that it's from C#
Ok, I will try to investigate it myself, since I don't know ;-)

SharpStream is a wrapper around the 2 different APIs for SAF and non-SAF. It has both input and output like in C#, while in Java those are usually different classes. Because a class could only extend one class, there is SharpInputStream and SharpOutputStream that wraps SharpStream while extending InputStream or OutputStream, so that you could use it with built-in Java stuff that supports InputStream or OutputStream.
